title: How glass bottles are recycled
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which used glass bottles are recycled.
instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Recycling glass bottles
steps: Used bottles are placed in collection banks
Bottles are taken by lorry to a recycling plant
Glass is washed to remove labels and dirt
Glass is crushed into small pieces called cullet
Cullet is melted in a furnace at about 1,500°C
Molten glass is moulded into new bottles
New bottles are filled and returned to shops

key_points: overview: a cycle of eight stages from collection to reuse
mention sorting, crushing and melting stages

title: How tea is produced
prompt: The diagram below shows the main stages in the production of black tea.
instructions: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: Producing black tea
steps: Young leaves are picked by hand
Leaves are spread out to wither for up to 18 hours
Withered leaves are rolled to break their cell walls
Leaves are left to oxidise and turn dark
Leaves are dried in hot air
Dried tea is sorted by leaf size
Tea is packed and transported to shops

key_points: overview: seven stages from picking to packing
